- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:120-127 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The updater-branch guard skips committing editor changes but leaves the worktree dirty, so the editor-changes-lost detector treats intentionally withheld changes as lost.
  WHY: This triggers unnecessary review redispatches and failure, warning, and heal-report paths, potentially repeating until the PR is blocked.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1928-1985 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The judge posts a `fix` or `close_and_reissue` assessment before the updater-branch hold prevents that action, without explaining the hold.
  WHY: PR readers see a verdict that was not carried out and receive no follow-up explaining why.
- changelog.d/7004-updater-pr-verify-job.md:line 4 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog claims no review push can land an unverified head, although the conflict-resolver path can still push to updater branches.
  WHY: The documented guarantee overstates the guard coverage and could mislead operators and maintainers.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:line 124 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `AUTOFIX_COMMIT_SKIPPED` log prefix is missing from the stable log-prefix registry in agents.md.
  WHY: Log-analysis tooling built from the registry will not recognize the prefix, making the skip signal invisible to automated reporting.

  WHY: Auto-merge enrollment persists across pushes, allowing an unchecked resolver head to merge; the next updater run also fails with `foreign_commits_on_branch`.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh, lines 120-127
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk in the resolver scripts or the Push step mentions `update-workflows`. Only review_commit_changes.sh, review_enable_auto_merge.sh, review_rb_judge.sh and the deterministic-skip job carry the guard.

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
